metricInfo.realizedSpread: Revenue already recognized after cash source costs.

metricInfo.surplusBalance: Borrower cash collected minus cash source costs when the result is positive. This includes returned principal and is not an overpayment.
metricInfo.deficitBalance: Cash source costs minus borrower cash collected when source cash outflow is greater.
metricInfo.borrowerCashCollected: All borrower cash received for this source: returned principal plus interest, fees, and penalties.
metricInfo.fundCostPaid: Cash costs already paid for this funding source, including interest, fees, VAT, and penalties.
metricInfo.deployedPrincipal: Principal allocated from this funding source to borrower loans.
metricInfo.netCashPosition: Borrower cash collected minus cash source costs paid.
metricInfo.realizedRoi: Realized spread divided by deployed principal, expressed as a percentage.
metricInfo.opportunityCost: Estimated non-cash cost of tying up own capital over time.
metricInfo.economicSpread: Realized spread minus the estimated opportunity cost of own capital.
metricInfo.contractRevenue: Interest, fees, and penalties attributed to this source from posted borrower payments.
metricInfo.ledgerRevenue: Revenue entries recorded in the append-only ledger for this funding source.
metricInfo.reconciliationDifference: Contract-attributed revenue minus ledger-recorded revenue. A non-zero amount needs review but does not change financial records.
